name: What are the benefits of upgrading to a tankless water heater during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading to a tankless water heater during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to a tankless water heater during a renovation offers several benefits, including on-demand hot water, significant energy savings due to not continuously heating a tank, and a longer lifespan compared to traditional tank heaters. They also free up valuable space, especially beneficial in smaller homes. As a practical tradeoff, tankless units have a higher initial installation cost, and sometimes require gas line upgrades or dedicated electrical circuits, but can offer long-term operational savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tankless water heaters provide on-demand hot water, save energy, and free up space. They have a higher upfront cost but offer long-term savings.
